attempts.bug_summary: Data page version 2 value accounting uses the row count instead of the encoded value count. Valid V2 pages containing nulls or repeated values can therefore cause premature termination or an incorrect value-count validation failure.

The returned page reader receives the row-group and column ordinals in reverse order. Header processing still uses the correct ordinals, but deferred page decryption will construct incorrect AAD for encrypted page data.
